## Type of Change

<!-- Check the one that applies. The commit type drives semantic-release versioning. -->

- [ ] `fix` — bug fix (patch)
- [ ] `feat` — new feature (minor)
- [ ] `feat!` / `BREAKING CHANGE` — breaking change (major)
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` — code improvement, no behavior change
- [ ] `docs` / `test` / `chore` — no release

## Checklist

- [ ] PR targets the `develop` branch
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `mvn clean verify` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or environment-specific endpoints committed
